user.title: Add Fluval Light
user.description: Select your Fluval light. Make sure the FluvalSmart phone app is fully closed first — the light only accepts one Bluetooth connection at a time. Fluval devices are marked with ★.

configure.title: Configure {name}
configure.description: How many colour channels does this light have? Flex and Aquasky are 4 (RGBW); Plant and Marine are usually 5.

abort.no_devices_found: No Bluetooth devices found nearby. Make sure the light is powered and the phone app is closed.
abort.not_supported: This device does not look like a Fluval light.
abort.already_configured: This light is already set up.
